logline: Still trapped after the thousand-year struggle, Gajendra remembers a prayer through divine grace and turns his mind to the Supreme Lord.

source.edition: Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam 8.3.1–29 original te/hi/en retelling; third-party modern translations not copied
source.verification_notes: S01 anchors exactly 8.3.1: Gajendra fixed his intelligence/mind and remembered a prayer learned in a previous life by divine grace. The previous king's name is intentionally withheld until later source-authored reveal, not denied. L002's exact quiet water sound is original staging. No Sanskrit phrase, Gajendra human lips, or early divine manifestation is authored. Actual prayers 8.3.2–29 belong to S02–S06. Checked 2026-11-22. S02: SB 8.3.2–4, simple narration of reverence to Supreme, source and witness of creation, protection. No unapproved Sanskrit mantra recording or a fabricated earlier physical deity vision.

core_preserved: Gajendra fixes mind and intelligence in his heart and remembers a mantra learned in a previous lifetime by the grace of the Lord (SB 8.3.1).
SB 8.3.2–4, simple narration of reverence to Supreme, source and witness of creation, protection. No unapproved Sanskrit mantra recording or a fabricated earlier physical deity vision.
changes: Episode 3 continues from E02's decision without duplicating a new bite, release or millennium montage.
Previous-life visual reveal is reserved for Episode 5 while honestly identifying the prayer's earlier-life origin here.
Subdued water sounds, close eye/trunk reaction and visual quiet are original screenplay staging, not scripture incidents.
The source's Sanskrit chant is NOT auto-created, substituted, or claimed recorded. Spoken lines are original child-friendly paraphrases under NARRATOR.
adaptation.fidelity_note: Direct meaning of SB 8.3.1 is retained, especially grace and remembered prayer. No copyrighted modern translation, invented elephant dialogue, new deity arrival or premature lotus offering.

scenes.action: Gajendra's inner prayer venerates the Supreme Person as the source, foundation and witness of life and creation, seeking protection. SB 8.3.2–4. No human animal lip-sync or early arrival of Lord Nārāyaṇa.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Though still caught, Gajendra steadied his mind.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు ఇంకా మొసలి పట్టులోనే ఉన్నా, తన మనసును నిలిపాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र अब भी मगरमच्छ की पकड़ में था, फिर भी उसने अपना मन स्थिर किया।
text.en: Though still caught, Gajendra steadied his mind.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Amid the struggle, his attention turned inward.

text.te: పోరాట శబ్దాల మధ్య అతని ధ్యానం లోపలికి తిరిగింది.
text.hi: संघर्ष के बीच उसका ध्यान अपने भीतर गया।
text.en: Amid the struggle, his attention turned inward.

source_attribution.note: Original quiet visual staging: Gajendra's attention turning inward amid existing water sounds. SB 8.3.1 states he fixed his mind and remembered prayer, but does not prescribe this precise soundscape or camera.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: A prayer he had learned long ago returned to him.

text.te: ఎప్పుడో నేర్చుకున్న ఒక ప్రార్థన అతనికి గుర్తొచ్చింది.
text.hi: उसे बहुत पहले सीखी हुई एक प्रार्थना याद आने लगी।
text.en: A prayer he had learned long ago returned to him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: It came from his devotion in an earlier life.

text.te: ఆ ప్రార్థన అతని గత జన్మలోని భక్తికి సంబంధించినది.
text.hi: वह प्रार्थना उसके पिछले जन्म की भक्ति से जुड़ी थी।
text.en: It came from his devotion in an earlier life.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: By the Lord's grace, the remembered prayer returned.

text.te: భగవంతుడి కృపతో ఆ మాటలు మళ్లీ అతని మనసులో మెదిలాయి.
text.hi: भगवान की कृपा से वे शब्द उसके मन में फिर जाग उठे।
text.en: By the Lord's grace, the remembered prayer returned.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra held his mind on that prayer.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు ఆ ప్రార్థనపై తన మనసును నిలిపాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने अपना मन उसी प्रार्थना पर टिकाया।
text.en: Gajendra held his mind on that prayer.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: In his heart, Gajendra bowed to the Supreme Person.

text.hi: मन ही मन गजेन्द्र ने परम भगवान को प्रणाम किया।
text.en: In his heart, Gajendra bowed to the Supreme Person.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He remembered the Lord as the source of all life.

text.te: సమస్త జీవుల జీవానికి మూలం ఆయనే అని గుర్తుచేసుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: उसे याद आया कि वही सब जीवों के जीवन का मूल हैं।
text.en: He remembered the Lord as the source of all life.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He meditated on the Lord present in every heart.

text.hi: उसने सबके हृदय में रहने वाले परमात्मा का ध्यान किया।
text.en: He meditated on the Lord present in every heart.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The whole creation rests upon the Lord.

text.hi: सारी सृष्टि का आधार वही भगवान हैं।
text.en: The whole creation rests upon the Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He is also its first cause.

text.te: ఆ సృష్టికి మొదటి కారణం కూడా ఆయనే.
text.hi: उस सृष्टि का प्रथम कारण भी वही हैं।
text.en: He is also its first cause.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Yet the Lord remains beyond His creation.

text.hi: फिर भी वे सृष्टि से परे रहते हैं।
text.en: Yet the Lord remains beyond His creation.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The power that reveals the world also comes from Him.

text.te: లోకం కనిపించేలా చేసే శక్తి కూడా ఆయనదే.
text.hi: संसार को प्रकट करने की शक्ति भी उन्हीं की है।
text.en: The power that reveals the world also comes from Him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He remains the witness of all that happens.

text.hi: वही हर घटना के साक्षी रहते हैं।
text.en: He remains the witness of all that happens.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra sought protection from that Supreme Lord.

text.te: ఆ సర్వోన్నతుడే తనను కాపాడాలని గజేంద్రుడు కోరుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने उन्हीं सर्वोच्च भगवान से रक्षा की आशा की।
text.en: Gajendra sought protection from that Supreme Lord.
